## What changed

Describe the change and why it is needed. Keep pull requests small and focused.

## How it was tested

Say what you ran (`npm test`, a real one-task run, a parallel run) and on which OS and versions.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] A selftest was added for every behavior change.
- [ ] No new dependency was added (or an issue was opened first).
- [ ] `README.md` was updated if behavior changed.
